Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end colilsion in Pasadena, Texas, where Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 1's
vehicle while both were stopped in traffic. Driver 1 stated that the impact pushed the vehicle forward and that the
Passenger was seated in the front passenger position at the time. Driver 2 acknowledged the collision and said the
impact occurred as Driver 1 described. Two witnesses at the scene gave statements consistent with that account.
Officers photographed the rear damage to Driver 1's vehicle and the front damage to Driver 2's vehicle, and the
dmaage patterns appeared consistent with the reported impact. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was noted.
Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. The Passenger was not identified by name
at the scene and did not request medical transport. Several days later, a claim was reported that included a wrist
injury to the Passenger.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
